# `sngl test` builds a Model from the component under test, which is only
# called `main` by coincidence. CodegenCtx.MainComponent is what knows that --
# it consults RootComponent first -- but html answered the same question by
# name, in eight places, through a private mainIRComponent(pkg).
#
# The two agreed for an ordinary build and disagreed for every test build of a
# component named anything else: html collected no state for it and emitted no
# binding, so a test asserting an initial value failed with no diagnostic.
#
# Renaming the component under test is the whole regression, so each file here
# is the same program twice under two names.

sngl test --platform none counter.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform none renamed.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform html counter.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform html renamed.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform bubbletea counter.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform bubbletea renamed.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- counter.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var n = 7
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
    }
}

func testInitial(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.n == 7)
}

window {
    main
}
-- renamed.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component counter node {
    var n = 7
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
    }
}

func testInitial(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.n == 7)
}

window {
}
